author: "Dustin Tharp"

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
n_observations <- sum(!is.na(billboard$wk1))
selected_weeks <- paste0("wk", c(1, 4, 10, 20, 40, 76))
ranking_completeness <- billboard |>
  summarise(across(
    all_of(selected_weeks),
    list(
      Present = \(x) sum(!is.na(x)),
      Missing = \(x) sum(is.na(x))
    ),
    .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
  )) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("Week", "Status"),
    names_pattern = "(wk\\d+)_(Present|Missing)",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Status, values_from = Count) |>
  mutate(Week = factor(Week, levels = selected_weeks)) |>
  arrange(Week)
ranking_table_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ranking_completeness)), \(i) {
  htmltools::tags$tr(
    htmltools::tags$th(as.character(ranking_completeness$Week[i]), scope = "row"),
    htmltools::tags$td(format(ranking_completeness$Present[i], big.mark = ",")),
    htmltools::tags$td(format(ranking_completeness$Missing[i], big.mark = ","))
  )
})

billboard_long <- billboard |>
  mutate(song = row_number()) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank"
  )

song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  summarise(
    artist = first(artist),
    track = first(track),
    first_rank = rank[which.min(week)],
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    weeks_on_chart = n(),
    .by = song
  )
top_10_songs <- song_summary |> filter(best_rank <= 10)
fastest_to_number_one <- top_10_songs |>
  filter(best_rank == 1) |>
  arrange(first_week_at_best, song) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  mutate(notable = "Fastest to #1")
slowest_to_number_one <- top_10_songs |>
  filter(best_rank == 1) |>
  arrange(desc(first_week_at_best), song) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  mutate(notable = "Slowest to #1")
longest_top_10_run <- top_10_songs |>
  arrange(desc(weeks_on_chart), song) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  mutate(notable = "Longest top-10 chart run")
notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  fastest_to_number_one,
  slowest_to_number_one,
  longest_top_10_run
)
notable_song_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(notable_songs)), \(i) {
  htmltools::tags$tr(
    htmltools::tags$th(notable_songs$notable[i], scope = "row"),
    htmltools::tags$td(notable_songs$artist[i]),
    htmltools::tags$td(notable_songs$track[i]),
    htmltools::tags$td(notable_songs$first_rank[i]),
    htmltools::tags$td(notable_songs$best_rank[i]),
    htmltools::tags$td(notable_songs$first_week_at_best[i]),
    htmltools::tags$td(notable_songs$weeks_on_chart[i])
  )
})

song_last_weeks <- billboard_long |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  summarise(last_week = max(week), .by = song)
week20_exits <- billboard_long |>
  filter(week == 20, !is.na(rank)) |>
  inner_join(
    song_last_weeks |> filter(last_week == 20),
    by = "song"
  )
n_week20_exits <- nrow(week20_exits)
n_week20_below_50 <- sum(week20_exits$rank > 50)

top_10_long <- billboard_long |>
  semi_join(top_10_songs, by = "song")
highlighted_songs <- notable_songs |>
  mutate(legend_name = paste(artist, "—", track))
highlighted_long <- top_10_long |>
  inner_join(
    highlighted_songs |> select(song, legend_name),
    by = "song"
  )
highlight_colors <- setNames(
  c("#35d6e8", "#a77bff", "#ff6cab"),
  highlighted_songs$legend_name
)

ranking_chart <- ggplot(
  top_10_long,
  aes(x = week, y = rank, group = song)
) +
  geom_line(
    color = "#778096",
    alpha = 0.34,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = highlighted_long,
    aes(color = legend_name),
    linewidth = 1.15,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = highlight_colors
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(10, 70, by = 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    limits = c(100, 1),
    breaks = seq(10, 100, by = 10),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Week on the Billboard Hot 100",
    y = "Billboard Hot 100 Rank"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#292d47", linewidth = 0.45),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#aeb8d0"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#d6d9e8"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 16)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 12)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#d6d9e8"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  )

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$style(htmltools::HTML("
    :root {
      color-scheme: dark;
      --page: #080b14;
      --surface: #111625;
      --surface-raised: #151b2b;
      --line: rgba(163, 176, 216, 0.14);
      --text: #f5f7ff;
      --muted: #9ca8c2;
      --purple: #a77bff;
      --cyan: #35d6e8;
    }
    html { background: var(--page); }
    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 0%, rgba(104, 67, 210, 0.16), transparent 36rem),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 95% 28%, rgba(28, 165, 196, 0.09), transparent 30rem),
        var(--page) !important;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    }
    #title-block-header { display: none; }
    #quarto-content, main.content {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: none !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
    }
    .music-dashboard {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      width: min(100% - 48px, 1220px);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: clamp(32px, 6vw, 72px) 0 80px;
    }
    .dashboard-hero {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-bottom: 30px;
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 26px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(110deg, rgba(112, 71, 210, 0.22), transparent 57%),
        linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(21, 27, 43, 0.98), rgba(12, 17, 30, 0.94));
      box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24), inset 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);
    }
    .dashboard-hero::after {
      position: absolute;
      top: -90px;
      right: -75px;
      width: 270px;
      height: 270px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(53, 214, 232, 0.18);
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 26px rgba(53, 214, 232, 0.025), 0 0 70px rgba(53, 214, 232, 0.1);
      content: '';
      pointer-events: none;
    }

      margin: 0 0 14px;

    }

      margin: 18px 0 0;
      color: #b2bdd3;
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.16rem);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .dashboard-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
      margin: 0 0 26px;
    }
    .dashboard-stat {
      display: flex;

    }
    .dashboard-stat:nth-child(2) {

    }

    .chart-heading { margin: 0 0 16px; }

    .ranking-completeness tbody tr:nth-child(even),

    .notable-songs {
      width: 100%;

    }
    .dashboard-chart .plotly, .dashboard-chart .plot-container {

    @media (max-width: 760px) {
      .music-dashboard { width: min(100% - 32px, 1220px); }

      .dashboard-chart { padding: 20px 14px; border-radius: 18px; }

  ")),
```
